indicator.subject: Mathematics
indicator.content_standard: B4.1.4.1 Develop an understanding of decimals (tenths and hundredths) using concrete and pictorial representations and write decimal fractions as base ten numbers with place value.
indicator.objective: Round decimals to the nearest tenth

skills.description: Round decimals to the nearest tenth.
Round decimals to the nearest hundredth (as per exemplar text).

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions: 5 at difficulty 1, 7 at difficulty 2, 5 at difficulty 3, 3 at difficulty 4.
misconceptions: Rounding down when the next digit is 5 or more.
Forgetting to drop the following digits after rounding.

questions.stem: What is 4.32 rounded to the nearest tenth?
hints: 2 is less than 5, so keep the tenths digit the same.
questions.explanation: The hundredths digit is 2. Since 2 < 5, we round down. 4.32 becomes 4.3.

questions.stem: What is 2.68 rounded to the nearest tenth?
hints: 8 is 5 or more, so round up.
questions.explanation: The hundredths digit is 8. Since 8 >= 5, we add 1 to the tenths digit. 2.68 becomes 2.7.

questions.stem: Round 5.41 to the nearest tenth.
hints: 1 < 5, so the tenths digit stays the same.
questions.explanation: 5.41 rounded to the nearest tenth is 5.4.

questions.stem: What is 0.95 rounded to the nearest tenth?
questions.explanation: 0.95 rounds up to 1.0.

questions.stem: Round 3.24 to the nearest tenth.
questions.explanation: 3.24 rounded is 3.2.

questions.stem: What is 7.15 rounded to the nearest tenth?
questions.explanation: 7.15 rounds up to 7.2.

questions.stem: Round 12.87 to the nearest tenth.
questions.explanation: 12.87 rounded to the nearest tenth is 12.9.

questions.stem: A pupil rounds 6.55 to 6.5. What mistake did they make?
options: They rounded down when the digit was 5 or more.
They rounded up when they shouldn't.
questions.explanation: The pupil should have rounded up to 6.6 because the hundredths digit is 5.

questions.stem: Round 0.36 to the nearest tenth.
questions.explanation: 0.36 rounded is 0.4.

questions.stem: Round 9.99 to the nearest tenth.
hints: This carries over to the whole number.
questions.explanation: 9.99 rounded to the nearest tenth is 10.0.

questions.stem: What is 4.05 rounded to the nearest tenth?
questions.explanation: 4.05 rounded to the nearest tenth is 4.1.

questions.stem: What is 1.44 rounded to the nearest tenth?
questions.explanation: 1.44 rounded is 1.4.

questions.stem: A bag of rice weighs 5.46 kg. What is this weight to the nearest tenth?
questions.explanation: 5.46 rounded to the nearest tenth is 5.5 kg.

questions.stem: Round 8.75 to the nearest tenth.
questions.explanation: 8.75 rounded to the nearest tenth is 8.8.

questions.stem: Explain the rule for rounding 3.68 to the nearest tenth.
hints: Which digit do you look at?
What do you do if it is 5 or more?
questions.explanation: Look at the hundredths digit, which is 8. Since 8 is 5 or more, you round up the tenths digit from 6 to 7. The answer is 3.7.

questions.stem: What is 10.33 rounded to the nearest tenth?
questions.explanation: 10.33 rounded is 10.3.

questions.stem: Round 2.96 to the nearest tenth.
questions.explanation: 2.96 rounded to the nearest tenth is 3.0.

questions.stem: Which number rounds to 8.0 when rounded to the nearest tenth?
hints: Look for the number that rounds up to 8.0.
7.95 has a 5 in the hundredths place.
questions.explanation: 7.95 has a 5 in the hundredths place, so it rounds up to 8.0. (8.15 rounds to 8.2).

questions.stem: Explain why 9.98 rounded to the nearest tenth is 10.0 and not 9.9.
hints: Round up the tenths digit (9 becomes 10).
What happens when you carry over?
questions.explanation: The hundredths digit is 8, so you must round up the 9 tenths. 9 tenths + 1 tenth = 10 tenths, which equals 1 whole. So 9.98 becomes 10.0.

criteria.description: Explains rounding up because of the 8.

questions.stem: A pupil says 0.45 rounded to the nearest tenth is 0.4 because 4 is in the tenths place. Are they correct?
questions.explanation: The pupil ignored the hundredths digit. Since it is 5, the tenths digit rounds up from 4 to 5. The answer is 0.5.
questions.misconception: Only looking at the tenths digit.
